baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive relative مَا تُوعَدُونَ is itself predicated by the singular صَادِق rather than merely being introduced as a report from a truthful speaker.
baseline_models.mechanism: The promise branch supplies speech that opens an anticipated future, while the two truth branches join correspondence in saying to verification in doing. Predicating truth of the promised content compresses announcement and eventual performance: the content is presented as carrying its own fulfillment-status.

activation_trace.role: A promise verbally opens an expected future, supplying the announced content that must cross from speech into event.
Truth as correspondence makes the promised content answerable to what it announces.
Verification of a promise by action turns صَادِق from a static label into the mechanism by which the utterance becomes deed.

changed_reading.before: What you are promised is a true statement about the future.
changed_reading.after: What you are promised is presented as a speech-event already bearing the force of its own eventual enactment: truthful because it will verify itself in action.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The unspecified مَا and passive تُوعَدُونَ allow the promise to be heard as an appointed encounter, while صَادِق bears nominal firmness.
baseline_models.mechanism: The appointment branch bounds promise by a time or place. The solidity and complete-stability branches of truth then give that appointment structural rather than merely verbal firmness: its coordinates are withheld, but its fixedness is asserted.

activation_trace.role: A موعد fixes promise to an appointed time or place, supplying a latent coordinate inside the indefinite مَا.
Material straightness and solidity lend the unseen appointment a firm, non-wavering structure.
Complete soundness and stability make the appointment whole and established even before its details are disclosed.

changed_reading.before: The verse guarantees an unspecified future prediction.
changed_reading.after: The verse guarantees an already fixed encounter: its time and place remain hidden from the addressees, but its appointment has the solidity of an established structure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive second-person plural تُوعَدُونَ and broad مَا leave both the agent and the value of the promised outcome unstated.
baseline_models.mechanism: The packet keeps hopeful promise and threatening warning as adjacent branches of the same focus root. The fulfillment branch of ص د ق applies to either valence, so the assertion can hold benefit and threat together without resolving them into one undifferentiated outcome.

activation_trace.role: Promise opens hope while explicitly allowing both good and bad, preserving a positive horizon within the broad relative.
Threat specializes promise toward harm, keeping a punitive horizon live beside hope.
Fulfillment in action is neutral between welcome and unwelcome outcomes, allowing both horizons to be realized truthfully.

changed_reading.before: The promise is either a reassuring good or a threatening evil.
changed_reading.after: The focus deliberately leaves polarity open: one truthful fulfillment can differentiate the plural addressees into hoped-for and feared outcomes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening oath unfolds as a transport system: dispersal sets material in motion, carriers bear weight, runners convey it with ease, and distributors allot the matter. This revises promise from a future proposition into an already operating chain whose truth is its reliable delivery.

activation_trace.role: A present sign that promises a coming condition lets the focus promise be read through precursor operations already visible.
Verification by action makes successful delivery, rather than assertion alone, the operative sense of truth.
Wind-driven scattering supplies the chain's initiating release and broad distribution.
Bearing a visible load supplies the transport stage that preserves what was released.
A heavy burden makes the carried content consequential rather than weightless imagery.
Continuous flowing motion carries the loaded process onward rather than leaving it suspended.
Light, compliant movement supplies low-friction transmission through the chain.
Separating and allotting shares converts undirected movement into delivery to distinct recipients.
A sign or appointed mark gives the distributed matter a designated endpoint and timing.

structural_cues: The four oath clauses proceed in packet order from release to bearing to transit to allocation.
Repeated active participles present the stages as ongoing agencies immediately before the focus assertion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered series of motion and allocation images; I supply the arrow that they are successive stages delivering the focus promise. A live alternative is that they are parallel witnesses whose operations resemble reliability without forming one pipeline.

changed_reading.before: The opening images merely swear that the later promise is true.
changed_reading.after: The opening images model how the promise is becoming true: released, carried with its full weight, conveyed without obstruction, and apportioned to its destinations.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next verse names reckoning or recompense and predicates falling-fixedness of it. This supplies both a likely content for the open-polarity promise and a physical completion for صَادِق: truth is what leaves prediction and lands as an established event.

activation_trace.role: The appointed-time branch keeps the promise oriented toward a bounded encounter.
Truth as performed verification supplies the transition from appointment to occurrence.
Accounting and recompense give the otherwise broad مَا a judicially consequential candidate content.
Falling and becoming fixed gives fulfillment a terminal motion: the promised matter comes down and stays.

structural_cues: 51:5 and 51:6 are adjacent parallel clauses, each reinforced by إِنَّ and predicative لَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel syntax, recompense, and falling-fixedness; I read 51:6 backward as specifying and materializing 51:5. It may instead be a separate corroborating assertion, leaving the promise's scope wider than recompense.

changed_reading.before: The promise is true because its report is trustworthy.
changed_reading.after: The promise is true because its accounting is appointed to land, become fixed, and confront the addressees as an event.

context_deltas.mechanism: An expertly woven order is followed by divergent speech, directional reversal, immersion, and inattentiveness. The contrast relocates instability from the promise to its receivers: صَادِق is the firm weave that persists while readings of it split, turn away, and become submerged.

activation_trace.role: Straightness and solidity supply an invariant object against which divergent reception can be measured.
Expert construction supplies an ordered fabric that can remain coherent despite observers' disagreement.
Externalized speech provides the medium in which competing receptions become audible.
Each party taking a different route turns disagreement into spatial divergence from a common object.
Reversal and diversion locate error in being turned away from the object's direction.
A covering haze of falsehood and ignorance explains how a coherent object can become unavailable to perception.
Heedlessness of the heart supplies the receptive failure that lets diversion persist.

structural_cues: The woven sky is immediately contrasted with speech characterized by اختلاف.
The uncitable branchless root خ ر ص at 51:10 structurally intensifies the sequence from disagreement to unsupported estimation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coherent weaving followed by divergent, diverted, submerged reception; I assign the weave to the promise's invariant truth and the distortions to readers. The live alternative is that the weave remains only an oath object and contributes no epistemic model.

changed_reading.before: صَادِق simply opposes a false proposition.
changed_reading.after: صَادِق marks a coherent invariant: the promised reality stays straight while human discourse forks into routes that turn away from and become veiled to it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The appointment latent in promise is challenged by asking when and trying to accelerate it. The answer moves from named day to fiery assay to tasting. Truth thus becomes a timed verification process that exposes the quality of those who demanded premature realization.

activation_trace.role: A promise bounded by an appointment supplies the hidden time whose absence provokes the question.
Verification in action lets the appointed report become an experienced test.
Questioning and requesting expose pressure for the promise's concealed timing to be disclosed.
A bounded day gives the appointment temporal edges.
Reckoning and recompense define what the bounded day operationally performs.
Assaying metal or persons makes realization diagnostically expose what was latent in the recipients.
Experiential tasting turns abstract truth into direct undergone knowledge.
Acceleration supplies the recipients' attempted counter-motion against the promise's appointed schedule.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from the interrogative أَيَّانَ to يَوْمَ, then to the imperative ذُوقُوا and deictic هَذَا.
The same فتنة appears first as a passive process and then as the addressees' possessed experience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a timing question, bounded day, assay, taste, and attempted acceleration; I connect them as stages by which the focus truth verifies and diagnoses. Alternatively, the assay may be only the consequence promised, not the mechanism of truth.

changed_reading.before: The promised event will eventually prove the statement correct.
changed_reading.after: The promise has its own resistant schedule; when it arrives, its truth is not merely observed but tasted as an assay that reveals the impatience and composition of its recipients.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hopeful side of promise becomes a circuit of reception and prior relinquishment. The protected receive what their Lord gives after having recognized a fixed claim in their own wealth for both requester and deprived. The صدقة branch inside ص د ق makes truth socially performative: promise is answered by truthful distribution before it is received as gift.

activation_trace.role: Promise opens a hoped-for good, supplying the positive pole later rendered as reception.
Charitable transfer and a due right place material relinquishment inside the semantic field of truth.
Taking possession supplies the receiving side of the circuit.
Giving supplies the transfer that converts hopeful promise into possessed benefit.
Nurturing, repairing, and completing make the giver's transfer an act that brings recipients to completion.
Accumulated wealth supplies the held stock from which prior distribution must occur.
A specific owned right prevents the transfer from being reduced to optional generosity.
The requester makes one recipient of the recognized right socially visible.
Deprivation names the unseen recipient whose lack still carries a claim without an expressed request.

structural_cues: The receiving construction ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ is followed by a retrospective account of prior conduct.
The pair السَّائِل / المَحْرُوم expands recognized entitlement beyond explicit demand.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine giving, human receiving, wealth, and a fixed right for two deprived classes; I close these into a reciprocal circuit and connect صدق to enacted transfer. A live alternative is a looser reward sequence without mirrored giving.

changed_reading.before: The truthful promise is a one-way future gift to worthy recipients.
changed_reading.after: The hopeful promise participates in a reciprocity of truth: recipients had already made another's right real in their wealth, and the promised good reaches them as a completing gift.

context_deltas.mechanism: The promise's omen branch is activated by signs in earth and selves, while certainty and inward sight describe their uptake. The future is therefore not wholly absent: it casts legible signatures into present material and embodied experience.

activation_trace.role: A promising indication from which a future condition is expected makes current evidence a partial mode of promise.
Correspondence between report and reality lets present signs answer to the promised future.
A manifest sign supplies a presently legible trace rather than a purely deferred proof.
Settled knowledge with doubt removed names the receptive state in which the trace becomes evidential.
The thing's own self or identity relocates evidence inside the addressee rather than only around them.
Insight of the heart supplies the act that recognizes an internal sign as correspondence.

structural_cues: The repeated وَفِي construction moves from earth to the addressees' own selves.
The rhetorical question أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ turns the asserted truth into a demand for present recognition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies present signs, certainty, selfhood, and insight; I infer that these signs are anticipatory imprints of the focus promise. They may instead establish only the promiser's power, leaving the promised content fully future.

changed_reading.before: The promise can only be verified when the future event arrives.
changed_reading.after: The promise is already partially present as signatures in world and self; its future fulfillment and current legibility are two temporal layers of the same truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact focus verb returns beside allotted provision and under the spatial rubric of what is above. Combined with the focus packet's preparedness mapping, promise becomes less like an unbacked statement and more like a reserved allotment whose stock and delivery remain out of sight.

activation_trace.role: Preparing equipment or a reserve supplies the exploratory image of a promise backed by provision already made ready.
Complete stability lets the hidden reserve be treated as established rather than speculative.
What is above and overarches supplies the concealed spatial register in which provision and promise are jointly placed.
An allotted gift turns promise into a recipient-specific share rather than an undifferentiated future.
The exact repeated promise token reopens hopeful anticipation beside provision and directly reconnects the later location to the focus wording.

structural_cues: 51:22 coordinates رِزْقُكُمْ and مَا تُوعَدُونَ under one repeated وَفِي السَّمَاءِ frame.
The same passive second-person plural promise form recurs at 51:22.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies co-location, allotted provision, exact lexical repetition, and a focus-side preparedness branch; I infer a backed reserve awaiting delivery. The live alternative is simple coordination of two distinct heavenly matters with no shared storage mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The addressees are told to trust an unseen promise.
changed_reading.after: The promise is imagined as already provisioned and allotted in a concealed reserve: unseen at the point of reception, but not unprepared or unbacked.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing oath spans above and below, replaces صَادِق with fixed reality, and measures that reality against the addressees' own speaking. The focus claim is thus grounded in an unavoidable embodied act: speech becomes the comparison by which the unseen promise is rendered as immediate as self-expression.

activation_trace.role: Truth of saying supplies the bridge to the addressees' own act of speech.
Solidity supplies the ontological force that the later حَقّ makes explicit.
Sovereignty and mastery authorize the oath that binds the comparison.
The overarching above supplies one pole of a total spatial span.
The below opposite the sky completes the span, leaving no external spatial domain for the promised reality.
Stable correspondence with reality upgrades truth from reliable saying to fixed actuality.
Equivalence supplies the explicit bridge between promised reality and an embodied certainty.
Actual speech supplies the immediate bodily benchmark against which the unseen is asserted to be equally real.

structural_cues: The final oath repeats the focus clause's إِنَّهُ لَ pattern while replacing صَادِق with حَقّ.
The comparison addresses the same plural audience through أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies total spatial scope, fixed reality, explicit equivalence, and the addressees' speech; I infer an embodied calibration of the focus truth. A live alternative is that speech serves only as a conventional certainty simile and not as a self-involving verification mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The promise rests on an external assertion that the audience may accept or deny.
changed_reading.after: The promise is calibrated to an act the audience cannot coherently disown: their own speaking becomes the immediate analogue for its reality, so even voiced doubt operates inside the comparison.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet-supplied ع د د target behind the focus token rather than the ordinary وعد morphology. It remains anchored to the exact focus occurrence and yields a coherent counted-prepared-appointed mechanism, but downstream prose should label it a mapped-root activation rather than a lexical claim about تُوعَدُونَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus packet maps و ع د at word 2 not only to وعد but also to ع د د, allowing the promised content to be explored as counted, provisioned, and recurrently timed.

activation_trace.role: Enumeration makes the promised content determinate item by item rather than vaguely abundant.
Prepared equipment or reserve makes each counted item ready for a coming need.
Counted time and recurrence convert preparation into a schedule.
Solidity makes the counted schedule firm rather than conjectural.

changed_reading.before: The promise is a broad assurance whose contents and timing remain wholly undifferentiated.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, what is promised is already inventoried, provisioned, and placed on a recurring clock; its truth is the firmness of that hidden preparation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the packet-supplied ع و م target behind the focus promise and combines swimming, year-cycles, and a crossing raft. The opening flow and later allotted provision keep it mechanically anchored, but it should be rendered only as an exploratory temporal-transport image, not as the ordinary lexical sense of وعد.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus packet's ع و م mapping for word 2 allows the promised future to be imagined as cargo moving through yearly currents toward the addressees.

activation_trace.role: Swimming or current-like travel turns futurity into sustained movement through a medium.
The yearly cycle supplies the temporal medium through which the promised content travels.
A raft that crosses water gives the moving promise a vehicle capable of reaching the far bank.
Complete stability keeps the traveling content intact across temporal movement.
Flowing motion in the opening sequence activates the promise-as-current image.
An allotted provision supplies the cargo whose destination is recipient-specific.

changed_reading.before: The future promise waits statically at an endpoint.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the promise is a stable allotment already crossing the currents of successive time toward its recipients.

strongest_changes: The opening oath became an operational delivery chain rather than a set of detached witnesses.
The adjacent وَاقِع made truth a promised event that lands and becomes fixed.
The testing sequence made fulfillment an experienced assay whose appointed schedule resists forced acceleration.
The earth/self signs made the future partially legible in the present.
The final equivalence with the addressees' own speech made the unseen promise embodied and self-involving.
summary.what_was_special: The focus survived as several coexisting mechanisms: performative fulfillment, fixed appointment, open good/threat polarity, distributed delivery, epistemic invariance, timed assay, reciprocal right, present signature, hidden reserve, and embodied equivalence. Packet-supplied split mappings also exposed counted-preparation and temporal-crossing readings that a conservative lexical synthesis would likely erase.
remaining_uncertainties: The logistics chain in 51:1-4 may be sequential delivery or only a series of parallel oath witnesses.
Recompense in 51:6 may specify all of مَا تُوعَدُونَ or only one major instance of it.
The gift/right circuit in 51:16-19 may be reciprocal mechanism or thematic juxtaposition.
The co-location of provision and promise in 51:22 does not prove a shared reserve despite making that model plausible.
The ع د د and ع و م activations are deliberately retained but remain form-distant packet mappings, not preferred lexical readings.
